description: This file defines threading and synchronization primitives for Android's binder RPC system, including classes for mutexes, condition variables, and thread management, with support for single-threaded and multi-threaded configurations.

classes.name: RpcMutex
classes.description: Mutex class for single-threaded configuration, with no-op lock and unlock methods.

classes.name: RpcMutexUniqueLock
classes.description: Unique lock class for RpcMutex, with no-op unlock method.

classes.name: RpcConditionVariable
classes.description: Condition variable class with no-op notify and wait methods for single-threaded mode.

classes.name: RpcMaybeThread
classes.description: Thread abstraction supporting creation, joining, and detaching, with different implementations for single-threaded and multi-threaded modes.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID for the current thread.

methods.name: rpcGetThreadId
methods.description: Returns a thread ID, either 0 in single-threaded mode or the actual thread ID.

methods.name: rpcJoinIfSingleThreaded
methods.description: Joins the thread if in multi-threaded mode; does nothing in single-threaded mode.
